title: ARABLE CROP PRODUCTION
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important exporter of the crop, Sierra Leone being the leading producer."
West Africa is an important exporter of the crop, Sierra Leone being the leading producer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important food crop grown in much of Nigeria, Ghana and to a lesser extent in Sierra Leone."
Maize is an important food crop grown in much of Nigeria, Ghana and to a lesser extent in Sierra Leone.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most productive crops in the world, yielding 15 tonnes of tubers per ha on an average, and over 30 tonnes per ha under the best growing conditions."
Cassava is one of the most productive crops in the world, yielding 15 tonnes of tubers per ha on an average, and over 30 tonnes per ha under the best growing conditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to achieve this spacing."
A space marker is used to achieve this spacing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an appropriate remedy, but is rather expensive."
Liming is an appropriate remedy, but is rather expensive.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a skilled job, otherwise the skin containing the volatile oil upon which the aroma and flavour depends may be injured."
Peeling of ginger is a skilled job, otherwise the skin containing the volatile oil upon which the aroma and flavour depends may be injured.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the third most important grain food in the world (wheat being the first and rice the second most important)."
Sorghum is the third most important grain food in the world (wheat being the first and rice the second most important).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to support the yam vines in order to obtain good yields by exposing maximum leaf area."
Stakes are used to support the yam vines in order to obtain good yields by exposing maximum leaf area.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important cash crop in Nigeria, Ghana and Sierra Leone."
Cotton is an important cash crop in Nigeria, Ghana and Sierra Leone.
fib: ______ is a leaf-eating beetle which defoliates the bean plant before flowering occurs thus causing reduced yields.
Ootheca Mutabilis
Ootheca Mutabilis is a leaf-eating beetle which defoliates the bean plant before flowering occurs thus causing reduced yields.
______ is an advantage since farmers are able to obtain a crop from the few pods set.
long flowering period
The long flowering period is an advantage since farmers are able to obtain a crop from the few pods set.
______ is used primarily as a green vegetable.
Dinner
Dinner is used primarily as a green vegetable.
______ is the second most serious pest of rice in Liberia.
groundhog
The groundhog is the second most serious pest of rice in Liberia.
______ is a coleoptera (beetle) which damages cowpea seeds inside pods.
Piezotrachelus varium
Piezotrachelus varium is a coleoptera (beetle) which damages cowpea seeds inside pods.
______ is a bruchid although commonly referred to as a weevil.
Callosobruchus maculatus
Callosobruchus maculatus is a bruchid although commonly referred to as a weevil.
______ is the best form to preserve and store yams.
Yam flour
Yam flour is the best form to preserve and store yams.
______ is used in the manufacture of textiles.
Cotton lint
Cotton lint is used in the manufacture of textiles.
